name: Blobun Mini
detailed_description:
A New Adventure on Pico8!

After the events of Blobun, Stephanie and her girlfriend decide to continue adventuring for fun! Take a small trip around Mythandra and solve many puzzles. Your goal is simple: touch every tile! However, it's not as simple as it sounds. Many obstacles get in your way, from floor zappers to deadly lava. You'll have to keep sharp to solve these puzzles!

This is not simply a remake of Blobun on Pico8. This game features all new puzzles using familiar puzzle elements, enjoyable by both new players and existing fans!

Puzzle Elements and States

During your journey, you'll come across many different types of puzzle elements, from toggle blocks to cracked floors, conveyer belts, and more. You'll have to learn what each puzzle element does and plan accordingly. In addition, you'll find state change tokens in some puzzles, allowing you to change to the fire or ice state. These will change how you engage with the puzzle!

Features

  • Made a wrong move? You can undo your mistake! There's also no time limit, and you can try each puzzle as many times as you like.

  • If a puzzle is too hard, you can skip it!  You only need to complete enough puzzles to progress.

  • Optional timers are available if you wish to test how fast you can beat each puzzle. However, you don't have to!

Options

  • Show Timers: If you want to challenge yourself, you can turn timers on and see how fast you can beat each puzzle. This is completely optional!

  • Slime Overlap: When disabled, you'll be prevented from overlapping your own trail. However, conveyer belts will still push you into it.

  • Sprint By Default: When enabled, Stephanie will move fast, and holding the Sprint button will make her move slow instead.

  • Music/Sound Effects: You can toggle these on and off.

  • Lesbians Allowed: This game features a lesbian protagonist. If you want to remove lesbians from the game, you can turn this off.
